text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 42, June 13, 1936 ]
TRANSFERRING THE EXECUTIVE SUPERVISION OVER OFFICES OF PROVINCIAL, CITY, AND
MUNICIPAL TREASURERS FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR TO THE DEPARTMENT
WHEREAS, by virtue of the provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five, a Government Survey Board
has been created for the purpose of recommending to the President needed reforms in the present organization
of the Government; and
WHEREAS, the said Government Survey Board has recommended that the offices of provincial, city, and
municipal treasurers be placed under the general administrative supervision of the Secretary of Finance;
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws and in
pursuance of the provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five, it is hereby directed that the general
administrative supervision heretofore exercised by the Secretary of the Interior over the offices of provincial,
city, and municipal treasurers be and prepare and promulgate such regulations as may be necessary for the
proper administration of their offices, without prejudice to the jurisdiction vested in the Bureau of Audits over
all matters of accounts and accounting.
Done at the City of Manila, this thirtieth of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and thirty-six, and
of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the first.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
